Manager.Name: Languages
Manager.Label: Manage Languages
Manager.Hint: Define the languages and set which ones each character knows.
Manager.DefinitionsHint: One per line: id | Label | target language code | universal (optional). The code is the real language used to produce gibberish.

GMSeesAll.Name: GM understands every language
GMSeesAll.Hint: GMs always see the original text.

Online.Name: Use online translation
Online.Hint: Translate word by word with the free MyMemory service (words are cached locally). If disabled or unreachable, offline pseudo-gibberish is used.
